title: Door-to-door survey of 1,600 Swedes
summary: Clas Svahn tells of Door-to-door survey of 1,600 Swedes, about unspecified at Sweden, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
I mean, we knocked doors and talked to
1,600 Swedes
>> and 10% of them had seen something.

plain: A Swedish researcher named Clas Svahn says that he and others once went door to door across Sweden and spoke with 1,600 people about strange things in the sky. According to Svahn, about one in ten of them said they had seen something, which, if true, would suggest such sightings are far more common than people admit.
